svg.aria-label: The lab cluster: one Brev VM running k3s. The control plane (kube-apiserver, datastore, scheduler, controller-manager) and the worker side (kubelet and containerd) run on the same node. Workloads: Envoy Gateway, Keycloak, a monitoring stack, LiteLLM in front of the upstream model API, cert-manager, Kyverno, a demo shop app, and the pi agent deployed as an ordinary Deployment that holds the real LiteLLM key and can reach the Kubernetes API and the internet.
